question: how much is shipping to the uk and how fast is it
expected_answer: Standard shipping in the UK is £4.95 and takes 2 to 3 business days. Express is £9.95 and arrives the next business day.

question: do u ship to australia?
expected_answer: No. Wrenfield only ships to the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.

question: Whats the cheapest way to ship in the US and how long will it take?
expected_answer: Standard shipping costs $6.95 and takes 3 to 5 business days. It is free on orders over $75.

question: ordering a grinder from Toronto. am I going to get charged duties when the parcel shows up?
expected_answer: No. For Canadian orders, duties and GST/HST are collected at checkout, so there is nothing to pay on delivery.

question: If I order at 3pm on a tuesday does it still ship today?
expected_answer: No. Orders placed before 1 pm local warehouse time on a business day leave the same day, so a 3 pm order leaves on the next business day.

question: my tracking says delivered but theres nothing at my door
expected_answer: Check around the delivery spot, ask neighbors, look for a delivery photo and wait until the end of the next business day. If it still hasn't turned up, contact Wrenfield with the order number and email; they open a claim with the carrier and send a replacement or a full refund.

question: I ordered like 30 min ago and changed my mind. how do i cancel
expected_answer: Orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of placing them: go to Account > Orders, open the order and click Cancel order.

question: i put the wrong adress on my order an hour ago, can i still fix it?
expected_answer: Yes. The address can be changed within 2 hours of placing the order: Account > Orders, open the order and click Edit address.

question: One of the things I ordered isn't in the box. What should I do?
expected_answer: First check whether the order shipped in more than one parcel (one tracking email per parcel, items marked ships separately on the packing slip). If the item is still missing, contact Wrenfield with the order number, the missing item and a photo of the packing slip, and they send it at no cost.

question: How long do I have to return something?
expected_answer: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, starting from Account > Orders.

question: is there a restocking fee if i return a machine i opened? it works fine
expected_answer: Yes. Opened espresso machines and grinders returned in working order have a 15% restocking fee, taken from the refund.

question: can I return a bag of coffee I already opened? didn't like the taste
expected_answer: Opened bags of coffee can't be returned. If a bag tastes wrong or arrived damaged, contact Wrenfield anyway and they will replace it.

question: how long does the refund take once you get my return
expected_answer: The refund is issued within 5 business days after the return reaches the warehouse, to the original payment method. The bank may take a few more days to show it.

question: can i swap my milk pitcher for the bigger size
expected_answer: There are no direct exchanges. Return the pitcher within 30 days of delivery and place a new order for the size you want.

question: how long is the warranty on a grinder? and on a scale?
expected_answer: Grinders have a warranty of 2 years. A scale is an accessory, so it has a warranty of 1 year.

question: my espresso machine pump just died. how do i do a warranty claim
expected_answer: Use the Warranty claim form on the Contact us page with the order number, the serial number and a short video of the problem. Wrenfield replies within 2 business days and, if approved, sends a prepaid shipping label and repairs or replaces the machine.

question: Is a worn out group head gasket covered by the warranty?
expected_answer: No. Gaskets are wear parts and aren't covered by the warranty. Replacements are sold in the Parts section of the store.

question: my machine is 3 years old and broke. can you still fix it and what does it cost?
expected_answer: Yes. Out-of-warranty repairs have a diagnostic fee of $49 in the US (C$65 in Canada, £39 in the UK), credited toward the repair if the customer goes ahead. The customer pays shipping to Wrenfield, and repairs take 10 business days.

question: where do i find the serial number on my grinder
expected_answer: On a sticker in the middle of the base: remove the hopper and tilt the grinder on its side. It is also printed on the side of the original box, next to the barcode.

question: how does the coffee subscription work and is it cheaper than buying bags?
expected_answer: A 340 g bag arrives every 2, 3 or 4 weeks. Subscription bags cost 10% less than one-off bags and always ship free.

question: going away for 6 weeks, can I stop my coffee deliveries while im gone?
expected_answer: Yes. The subscription can be paused for up to 3 months from Account > Subscriptions. The change has to be made at least 48 hours before the next ship date.

question: how do I cancel my subscription? is there a fee
expected_answer: Go to Account > Subscriptions and click Cancel subscription. There is no fee. Cancel at least 48 hours before the next ship date, or the next bag still ships and is charged.

question: Can I get my coffee every 3 weeks instead of every 2?
expected_answer: Yes. In Account > Subscriptions, click Edit and choose every 3 weeks (the options are every 2, 3 or 4 weeks). Change it at least 48 hours before the next ship date.

question: do you take discover card in canada
expected_answer: No. Discover is only accepted on US orders. In Canada you can pay with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or a Wrenfield gift card.

question: can i use two discount codes on the same order
expected_answer: No. Only one coupon per order, and codes can't be combined with each other or with the subscription discount.

question: I bought a kettle last week and now it's cheaper on your site. can I get the difference back?
expected_answer: Yes. If the price dropped within 14 days of the order, contact Wrenfield with the order number and they refund the difference to the original payment method.

question: are your uk prices including vat?
expected_answer: Yes. UK prices include 20% VAT, and since UK orders ship from Leeds there are no import duties.

question: my cart is $80 and I have a $10 off code. do I still get free shipping?
expected_answer: No. Free shipping is based on the total after discounts. $80 minus $10 is $70, which is under the $75 needed in the US, so standard shipping is charged.

question: how often should I descale and how long does it take?
expected_answer: Every 2 months, or every month with hard water. The descaling cycle takes about 25 minutes.

question: when do the burrs on my grinder need replacing?
expected_answer: After about 300 kg (660 lb) of coffee, which is about 3 years of daily home use. The swap takes about 15 minutes with the 2.5 mm hex key that comes with the grinder.

question: my shots are running way too fast. what should i change?
expected_answer: Grind finer by one step and keep the dose the same. The espresso target is 18 g of coffee in and 36 g out in 25 to 30 seconds, starting from setting 8.

question: steam wand is weak and kinda sputtering. how do i clean it?
expected_answer: Let the wand cool, unscrew the steam tip, soak it in warm water with milk cleaner, clear the holes with the pin from the cleaning kit, then screw it back on and purge. If the holes are clear and the steam is still weak, descale the machine.

question: what's the best way to keep the group head clean
expected_answer: Backflush the group head with the blind basket: once a week with plain water and once a month with cleaning powder.

question: are you guys open on saturdays?
expected_answer: Yes, on Saturday from 9 am to 1 pm ET. On weekdays support is open from 8 am to 6 pm ET.

question: do you have a phone number I can call?
expected_answer: No, there is no phone support. Customers can use the chat or the Contact us form, and the team replies within 1 business day.
